about.heading: Making complex equipment simple to operate
about.paragraph_1: ANHEL® is a brand of Profit LLC. We design and manufacture modular pumping stations, block-modular heat substations, water treatment systems and control cabinets. We work with industrial and commercial facilities across Russia.
about.paragraph_2: We run our own engineering office and assembly shop. Every module passes hydraulic and electrical bench testing before shipment — equipment arrives on site ready for commissioning.
about.paragraph_3: We cover the full cycle with a single team: sizing and selection → engineering → manufacturing → installation and commissioning → service. One contract, one point of responsibility, one schedule.

production.heading: Full cycle on a single site
production.lede: Engineering office, assembly shop and test bench under one roof. From sizing to shipment — without hand-offs between subcontractors.
production.capacity_title: A single manufacturing site under one roof
production.capacity_description: Our own shop covers metal cutting, welding, piping and control-cabinet assembly. Every stage — from the first line in DWG to live-pressure testing — runs on the same site, with no hand-offs between subcontractors.
production.cycle_title: From sizing to service — one company
production.cycle_description: One contract, one point of responsibility, one schedule. The ANHEL team carries the project from the first calculation against your brief through to service after commissioning.

step1.title: Design
step1.body: Sizing to your site parameters, working documentation in DWG, PDF, IFC.

step2.title: Manufacturing
step2.body: Built in-house. Every module is assembled to a specific project.

step3.title: Supervised installation
step3.body: Site supervision and designer oversight at key milestones.

step4.title: Commissioning
step4.body: Start-up, tuning and hand-over in 1–3 shifts.

production.process_title: Engineering office, assembly shop and test bench

design.title: Engineering office
design.body: Hydraulic and thermal calculations, equipment and automation selection to your site parameters. Working documentation issued in DWG, PDF and IFC.

assembly.title: Assembly shop
assembly.body: Frame fabrication, pump and heat-exchanger installation, piping, cable routing, control cabinet assembly. Every module is built to order — not catalogue stock.

testing.title: Test bench
testing.body: Each unit undergoes hydraulic and electrical testing before shipment. Operating modes are simulated, parameters recorded in the test report. On site, the module is ready for commissioning in 1–3 shifts.

iso.title: ISO 9001:2015
iso.body: Our quality management system conforms to GOST R ISO 9001-2015 (ISO 9001:2015).

control.title: Bench testing
control.body: Every unit undergoes mandatory technical inspection and regulated bench testing on our own test rig before shipment.

certificates.title: EAEU declaration
certificates.body: EAEU declarations of conformity, technical specifications and supporting documentation — issued for every product.

showcase.title: Four product lines, one factory
showcase.lede: Pumping stations, water treatment, heat substations and control cabinets. Factory assembly, serial production, configured to your specification.
